# Levidev Studio

> Levidev Studio builds open-source-first software: developer tools, Chrome extensions, apps and AI agent skills. A small studio, started as a weekend project.

We build the product, and the tools that build it.

## Principles
- Agentic first. Agents draft, search and test. A person reviews, decides and signs off. Speed comes from the loop, not from skipping it.
- Open-source first. When we build a tool for ourselves, it ships on GitHub. Read the code before you trust it, and fork it if we stop.
- Clarity first, built to last. Plain interfaces, written decisions and tests that explain intent, so the work still makes sense a year later.

## What we make
- Software Engineering: Mobile, web and backend software, built in the open.
- Game Development: Small, polished games and playful interfaces.
- AI Systems: Agent workflows, retrieval and the tooling around them.
- UI & UX Design: Interfaces that explain themselves.
- Software Publishing: Our own apps and agent skills, released in the open.

## Tools
- [Levistack](https://levidev.studio/tools/levistack/): Guide a coding agent through a checked workflow. It does not mark a step done without a check.
  - Source: https://github.com/pahlevikun/levistack
  - Install: `npx skills add pahlevikun/levistack`
- [ApplyDiff](https://levidev.studio/tools/applydiff/): Review CV changes before exporting a PDF. It does not submit applications or invent numbers.
  - Source: https://github.com/pahlevikun/applydiff
- [mdz](https://levidev.studio/tools/mdz/): Turn a web page into Markdown. Fetching a page and keeping the result local are different steps. Check the repository for network behavior.
  - Source: https://github.com/pahlevikun/mdz
- [Sorot](https://levidev.studio/tools/sorot/): Open text tools at your cursor on Mac. Check the repository for what stays on the Mac in the current build.
  - Source: https://github.com/pahlevikun/sorot
- [Logo Kit SVG](https://levidev.studio/tools/logo-kit-svg/): Create four SVG logo files from your repo's colors. It does not invent a palette when the repo already has one.
  - Source: https://github.com/pahlevikun/logo-kit-svg
  - Install: `npx skills add pahlevikun/logo-kit-svg`
- [Polyglot Copywriter](https://levidev.studio/tools/polyglot-copywriter/): Revise source text with language-specific writing guidance. An instruction not to add facts is not a guarantee of every model output.
  - Source: https://github.com/pahlevikun/polyglot-copywriter
  - Install: `npx skills add pahlevikun/polyglot-copywriter`
- [seatpack](https://levidev.studio/tools/seatpack/): Copy Chrome profiles and Cursor, VS Code, and Android Studio plugins when you change Macs. An account that is already signed in stays in place.
  - Source: https://github.com/pahlevikun/seatpack-chrome-backup
  - Install: `npx skills@latest add pahlevikun/seatpack-chrome-backup`
- [seatsweep](https://levidev.studio/tools/seatsweep/): Scan a Mac account and delete only the categories you name. It does not erase the Mac, delete the user, or sign out of iCloud.
  - Source: https://github.com/pahlevikun/seatsweep-macos-cleanup
  - Install: `npx skills@latest add pahlevikun/seatsweep-macos-cleanup`
- [Evidence-first App Builder](https://levidev.studio/tools/evidence-first-app-builder/): Plan an app stage by stage, with docs and design before code. A checklist tick needs proof, not an agent's word.
  - Source: https://github.com/pahlevikun/evidence-first-app-builder
  - Install: `npx skills add pahlevikun/evidence-first-app-builder`
